reports.title: PINNACLE WEST REPORTS 2026 THIRD-QUARTER FINANCIAL RESULTS

guidance.heading: Financial Outlook
section: Given the positive customer and sales growth and impact of weather through the first three quarters of the year, the company is adjusting its 2026 consolidated earnings guidance upward to a range of $5.05 to $5.25 per diluted share.
Key factors and assumptions underlying the 2026 outlook can be found in the third-quarter 2026 earnings presentation slides at pinnaclewest.com/investors.
